docs.title: Witch Launcher — Repository Overview
docs.desc: The iOS and iPadOS launcher that brings Minecraft: Java Edition to iPhone and iPad. This repository is a community fork of Amethyst-iOS, maintained by DuyAnh662 (Zad626).

docs.title: Security model
docs.desc: Every package is signed with ECDSA P-256 and SHA-256 (ES256). The signature is stored in witch-plugin.sig and covers the exact bytes of checksums.json.
